description: Land Acquisition - Bendiyamulla, Gampaha D/S Division, Gampaha District  and An Amendment to the Gaz. Ex. Ord. No. 1952/13 of 02.02.2016 Naula D/S Division
reasoning: This gazette content exclusively concerns land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains two separate notices under Section 7 of the Act: one announcing the government's intention to acquire a specific land parcel in Gampaha District for public purposes, and another providing a rectification to a previously published land allotment number. The content focuses entirely on land-related administrative procedures, descriptions of properties, and acquisition processes, fitting squarely within the Land Gazette classification (Type 4).
